stem: The Twelfth Amendment established a new process for choosing a president and a vice president. The purpose of this amendment was to —

options.label: F
options.text: prevent the concentration of power in the executive branch

options.label: G
options.text: ease the eligibility requirements for holding federal office

options.label: H
options.text: keep state officials from exerting undue influence on presidential elections

options.label: J
options.text: reduce the likelihood of disputed outcomes in presidential elections
